style_baseline.description: Original cute Q-version fantasy, clean thick line art, soft cel shading, warm muted palette, readable silhouette at 256px.
style_baseline.rule: Every character, portrait and preview derives from the CHR_001 reference by image-to-image so one design sheet stays authoritative.
style_baseline.note: Reports live under docs/ so the manifest's provenance reference survives a fresh clone; raw generations stay in build/gen and are not committed.

backends.name: workbuddy-image-gen
backends.notes: Returns RGB only; backdrop must be keyed locally. Corner watermark is baked in.

backends.name: miora
backends.notes: Only video-effect and 3D commands are wired into this workspace; no image command is reachable.

tasks.prompt: Full body standing idle sprite of the same chibi boy from the reference image: messy brown hair, large blue eyes, green hooded cloak with gold trim, cream tunic, brown leather belt and boots, small brass lantern at his hip. Original cute fantasy Q-version style, clean thick line art, soft cel shading. Facing the viewer, standing straight, arms relaxed at sides. Entire body visible from head to boots with margin. Background is one perfectly flat uniform solid magenta color #FF00FF filling the whole canvas, no gradient. No ground, no floor, no shadow, no glow, no border, no text, no logo.

Isometric 45-degree game scene background for a fantasy exploration hub: a quiet stone courtyard with mossy flagstones, a low broken colonnade, hanging vines, floating pale blue lanterns, distant misty green cliffs, warm afternoon light. Original cute Q-version fantasy style, soft painterly shading, clean shapes suitable for a 2.5D game map viewed from a fixed isometric camera. No characters, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermark. Wide composition that tiles cleanly at the edges.
